metadata.title: Retro Pin-up Illustration with Technical Line Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a hyper-realistic, airbrushed female figure in a pin-up pose reclining across a minimalist, technical line-art sketch of a vehicle. The figure is rendered with soft, glowing skin tones and detailed textures, while the environment remains an unfinished, pale red outline on a stark white field.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between fully rendered subject and skeletal line-art background
Diagonal tension created by the reclining figure's limbs
Juxtaposition of soft airbrushed skin against sharp technical contours
Top-left typographic weight balancing the bottom-right figure mass
coreInvariants: Sheer black mesh texture on the torso
Pale red or terracotta technical outlines for the vehicle
Highly saturated red hair and nails

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central reclining figure, occupying approximately 70% of the horizontal span, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the figure's torso and the vehicle's hood line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top-left text, follows the diagonal line of the legs down to the heels, then sweeps up through the torso to the face and raised arm.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white background that isolates the subject and emphasizes the technical sketch.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) overall with localized high saturation in the hair and high contrast in the black elements.
paletteRestrictions: No heavy shadows in the background
Limited to primary skin tones, black, and red accents

characterSpecificRedesigns: Bold weight for the primary name
Regular or Light weight for the secondary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic and stroke consistency.
Provides the necessary industrial feel for the technical theme.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a redhead woman in a sheer black bodysuit reclining on a faint, red-pencil technical sketch of a vintage car hood, all on a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in the top left corner using a bold Neo-Grotesque sans-serif font in solid black, followed by a hyphenated title in a lighter weight of the same font.

verificationChecks: Is the background a clean white?
Does the car appear as a light line-art sketch rather than a 3D object?
Is the bodysuit texture visibly porous/mesh-like?
Is the text strictly left-aligned in the top corner?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the technical car lines
Thickness of the black mesh texture
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likenesses
Unique car silhouette to avoid trademarked designs

mustAchieve: Delicate, precise line work for the vehicle

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the reclining pose
Ensure the sheer fabric effect is convincing without being photographic
Verify the text does not overlap the figure
Confirm the red accents (hair/nails) are the most saturated elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Airbrushed Pin-up Subject] with [Technical Line-Art Object] on [White Void] with [Bold Left-Aligned Sans-Serif Typography].
